notes: Held-out generalization set for the two descriptions revised on 2026-08-31 (code-organization, mental-models). Written BEFORE the re-run and deliberately not reusing the wording of the revised descriptions, so a pass here is not the description matching itself. The two near-miss distractors exist to catch the opposite failure: a revised description that now over-triggers. `distractor-rename-folder` uses folder/naming vocabulary on a mechanical task; `distractor-econnreset` uses the phrase root cause on a factual question. Both must answer null.

prompts.prompt: This service has grown to about 40 files under src/ and I can no longer tell which ones belong together. Every time I change how a booking is priced I end up editing four different folders. Sort it out.
I am about to add a second payment provider to this codebase. Where should the provider-specific code go so that adding it does not force changes to the first one?
We have utils.js, helpers.js and common.js, and two of them import each other. What should this look like instead?
Checkout conversion dropped eight percent last Tuesday and has not recovered. Three changes shipped that day and marketing also swapped the homepage hero. Work out what actually caused it.
The team is split between rewriting the sync worker and patching it. Help me think the decision through properly rather than just picking one.
I have convinced myself the memory leak is in the image resizer, but I have only looked at that one file. Before I spend a day on it, help me check that conclusion.
Rename the utils folder to lib and update the imports.
